rows.text: Need to change delivery address, it's wrong!!

Hello, I placed an order for a garden shed on order LK-482913 last week and I need a VAT receipt for my records. Could you send a proper invoice showing the VAT amount and my billing details? Thank you very much. Marie

Hi! The bed linen set arrived and the delivery was smooth, thanks. I also got my refund from last month sorted and I can log in fine now. Could you email me a VAT receipt for the linen set? I need it for my expenses. Cheers, Dana

I bought a petrol lawn mower on order LK-205177 and I'm fed up with unclear information. What exactly does the guarantee cover, and for how long? The box says one thing and the website says another. I need a straight answer.
Courier left my barbecue grill with the neighbours, not at my door. I used my login fine, just need this sorted asap.
Oh no, kettle handle broke, repair possible?
Hello, I was locked out of my account after too many attempts while trying to check on my log store order LK-739104. Could you help me regain access? Regards, Sam

I want my account deleted and all my personal data removed. The compost bin on order LK-118362 arrived fine, but I'm done with you. I'm also still waiting on a refund from last month that I shouldn't have to chase. Please delete everything.

Hi, my watering can on order LK-660125 was marked as delivered but it isn't at my door. The courier may have left it somewhere else and I'm really worried it's gone. Could you check where it was left and what happens next? Thank you, Priya

I already sorted the delivery date and the address on order LK-903348 for the leaf blower, and that all looks fine now. I entered the code SPRING15 at checkout but the total still shows full price. Why isn't the discount applied?
Charged $12 more than checkout total LK-317560
hi so i need to send back the bird feeder order LK-552019 its too big for post can u book a collection pickup this week thx dan

Thank you for your earlier help with my sizing question. That matter is now resolved and I appreciate the assistance. I would now like to arrange a collection for a bulky return of the leaf blower, as it exceeds the postal size limits. Could you advise on the available collection dates? Yours faithfully
Kettle arrived and works great. Instalments or bank transfer possible?

I tried to buy the cast iron frying pan and my card was declined at checkout. The same card works fine in other shops, and my login details are correct. I got a refund on a previous order, so the card is in good standing. Can you look into why the payment failed?

Good afternoon, I have been using the fire pit I bought for a few weeks and noticed the base has started to crack and gets very hot on one side. I wanted to let you know in case it's a safety issue for others. Could you advise what I should do? Kind regards

Hi there! My cordless hedge trimmer was supposed to arrive today, but the courier left it with my neighbour instead of at the door. Could you let me know how to get it back, or who I should speak to? Thanks so much, Joanne

I already checked my spam folder and the tracking page, and I've confirmed the address on order LK-771086 is correct. The solar path lights were due three days ago and nothing has arrived. Can you tell me where the parcel is and when it will actually get here?

I already emptied my basket and restarted the browser, so I've tried those. My bank says the card is fine and I've used it at other shops this week. Could you please check why the payment for the hammock keeps being declined?

Thank you for helping me with the refund amount on my last order, that's all sorted now. The greenhouse I received is damaged in a way that makes it unusable, so I need to send it back. Would it be possible to arrange a collection for this bulky item? Many thanks.

Good afternoon. This is not a damage or late-delivery issue, as my rattan patio set arrived in good condition. The set is heavy, however, and I need the delivery to be handled by two people. Could you arrange a two-person delivery for my order?

Thanks for sorting out my billing question so quickly last week, that's all fine now. I've decided the curtain pole isn't right for our window, so I'd like to send it back. Could you send me a return label or the return instructions?

Hi, I'm sorry to write with bad news. My bird feeder arrived today with the box crushed on one side and the glass tube broken inside. I've attached photos of the packaging and the damaged feeder. How should I report this for transit damage, and can you send a replacement?
My card was declined at checkout for the bed linen set, but it works fine everywhere else. Order LK-194027 didn't go through. Can you check why?

I ordered the hammock about ten days ago and the first courier attempt was handled without any problems. The tracking has been stuck on 'in transit' since Monday, though, and nothing has changed since. Could you check where it is?

Hi there! I'm really keen on the bathroom cabinet on order LK-605318 but the total is a bit much to pay at once. Do you offer paying in instalments, or could I pay by bank transfer instead? Thanks so much!

We put the trampoline together last weekend and the kids have been living on it since. It was bought during the spring sale, though, and we've already opened and assembled it. Can a sale or opened item still be returned if we change our minds?

My bed linen set arrived fine last week, and the refund I had last month was sorted without fuss. Today I can't log in because the password reset email never reached my inbox. I've checked spam too. Could you help me get back into my account?

I'm sorry to bother you, I'm really worried about this. The folding parasol on order LK-739012 is quite heavy and I don't want the driver trying to carry it alone. Could a two-person delivery be booked for it? I'm not sure how that works, so any guidance would mean a lot.

This is not a query about my order LK-410865 or its delivery, which I have no complaints about. I would like my account and all of my personal data deleted from your system. Please confirm the steps required and when the deletion will be completed.

The cushion covers were perfect when they arrived and the delivery was fine too. After a few washes, though, the seam on one of them has split open. I'm not asking for a refund yet. How do I go about getting this fault looked at?

My cast iron frying pan was marked as delivered today, but the courier left it with my neighbour without asking me. I never agreed to that and I'm not happy about it. Please sort this out and let me know what happens next.

I've been locked out of my account after too many login attempts, which is ridiculous since I only mistyped the password a few times. I need to get into my account to check on my raised vegetable bed order. Please unlock it now.
hi so i just paid for the kitchen bin and the amount charged is higher than what i saw at checkout. i screenshotted the price before paying. why is it different and can u fix it asap
Request to exchange kitchen bin LK-738210 for another colour.

Sorry to bother you again, I'm a bit nervous about this. I bought the kitchen bin on sale last week under order LK-160935 and the box is already opened. I had a refund on a different order last month which went smoothly, and I can still log in fine. Can a sale or opened item still be returned?
I've just checked my bank statement and I was charged twice for the paddling pool, same order and same amount. This is not what I expected. Please refund the duplicate payment.

The delivery of our garden shed last spring was smooth, and I had no issues with my earlier refund on a cushion either. Unfortunately one of the roof panels has warped since the summer. Could you arrange a replacement under the guarantee?

The last courier turned up with a dented box and I'm still annoyed about it, so I'd like this sorted properly. My rattan patio set on order LK-082463 needs two people to bring it in because of its weight. Could someone book a two-person delivery for me?

The cordless hedge trimmer arrived in good condition and I've tested it on a small section of hedge, which worked well. After some thought, I have decided I would like to send it back. Could you let me know how to arrange the return?

Good afternoon. The tracking for my LED desk lamp says delivered on Tuesday, but nothing has reached my door and my neighbours haven't seen it either. I did get a refund on a different order last month, which was handled well, and my login works fine, so this is only about the lamp. Could someone look into where the parcel went? Thank you kindly, Marguerite
hey so i keep getting marketing emails about the garden shed even tho i unsubscribed like 2 weeks ago lol. can u take me off the mailing list pls? thx
Greenhouse panel cracked, need replacement under guarantee

Hi there, I hope you are well. Last spring my husband and I bought the fire pit for the back patio, and we have spent almost every evening since sitting around it with a cup of tea, so it has become a real favourite in our house. When it arrived it was exactly as described, and the setup took us about an hour on a Saturday with a glass of wine and a lot of laughing at the instructions. Anyway, the reason I am writing is that my old email address has been getting strange spam lately, and I moved everything over to a newer one that I use for work. I would like the email address on my account changed to the new one so that order updates reach me properly. Could you let me know what you need from me to do that? Thanks so much, Carol

I already received your apology email about the cushion covers and the mix-up with the colour is acknowledged, so that part is sorted. I'm still annoyed though, because the box had grey covers when I ordered navy, and I spent most of Saturday on the phone trying to get someone to understand that. Please tell me how I can send the wrong ones back.
Courier marked my hammock as delivered on Tuesday but nothing arrived. Please look into it.
Cast iron frying pan order hasn't arrived and the delivery date passed on Friday. Can you check?

Hi! The lid hinge on my log store snapped after about three months of normal use, nothing heavy or unusual, just opening and closing it. Last year I got a refund on a kettle from you and that was painless, and I can't remember my login password right now, but that's a separate thing. Could you arrange a repair or a replacement hinge? Thanks, Dev

I know it's been a while since I posted the cushion covers back, and I keep checking the tracking every morning like it's my job. My sister says postal returns take ages, and I did get the email saying the label was scanned, so I'm trying not to panic. Could you tell me whether my return of the cushion covers has actually been received?
Not missing, and no refund needed. The courier left my rattan patio set with the neighbour next door without asking me first. Could you make sure it goes to the front porch next time?

I have to say I'm really fed up. Last week I ordered a bathroom cabinet as a surprise for my partner's birthday, and it was supposed to be a lovely thing to fit this weekend. When the box arrived the corner was completely crushed, and when I opened it the mirror door was smashed into pieces with glass all through the packaging. I took photos straight away and I spent the whole evening tidying up glass from the hallway carpet, which was not how I wanted to spend my Friday. I'm not interested in waiting weeks while someone looks at it, so I'd like you to replace the cabinet and arrange collection of the broken one as soon as possible.

I sent the rattan patio set back last week and the tracking has shown it sitting at the depot for three days. Could you confirm whether the return has been received? I'd like a clear answer today, please.

Hi, the garden hose reel that arrived is the wrong model, the fittings and the colour are not what I ordered. I'm worried about the return costing me money. Could you tell me how to send it back and what I need to do to arrange the return?

Hello, I'd like to book a two-person delivery for my tool chest. It's quite heavy and I live alone, so I can't lift it without help. Could you arrange a weekday morning slot if one is available? Thank you.

Not a delivery problem, and I don't want a refund at this stage. My wooden garden bench was delivered in good order, under order number LK-483920. Could you please explain what the guarantee covers and for how long it lasts? Yours faithfully, Helen Marsh

Thank you for the prompt confirmation of my order earlier this week, and for the helpful estimated date you provided. The cast iron frying pan was dispatched as stated, which I appreciate. However, the tracking has not been updated for several days now. Could you please look into this?
Lawn mower charged higher than checkout price, LK-719284
Delete my account and all my personal data, now.

Hi, my petrol lawn mower started leaking oil from under the engine about three weeks after I got it. It wasn't leaking when it arrived, so it's clearly something that developed later. Could you tell me what to do next? Thanks!

Honestly this is the second time I've had to write in. The trampoline frame has developed a loud grinding noise from the motor area that wasn't there at the start, roughly a month after I set it up. I got a refund on a different item from you last year, which was fine, and my login works, so that's not the problem. The trampoline itself is faulty, so please arrange a repair or a replacement.

Hi, my robot vacuum stopped working about three months after I started using it every other day. It powers on but won't charge anymore and the dock light just blinks. Order LK-482913. The delivery was smooth and I got a login reset last week, but this is about the vacuum no longer running. What's the next step?

Good morning, I'm hoping you can help me arrange delivery of my order. Along with the robot vacuum I also bought a large garden shed, which will need two people to carry it in. Could I book a two-person delivery for it? Many thanks.

Dear Larkfield support, I am writing regarding my paddling pool, order LK-71306. The tracking has not updated for six days. To be clear, this is not a damaged or missing parcel, and I do not wish to cancel the order or receive a refund. Could you please confirm the current status of the parcel?

Good afternoon. I would be grateful if you could provide a return label or instructions for returning a folding parasol that does not suit the space in my garden. Kindly advise how I should proceed. Yours faithfully, Margaret Ellis

Hello, the bird feeder I bought has a cracked base after about a month. The delivery was smooth and the refund on the earlier mat I sent back came through, thanks. Since the feeder is still under guarantee, could I get a replacement? Thanks, Priya
ok so i keep getting marketing emails from you guys even after i unsubscribed twice!!! order LK-390175 was fine but im done with the spam. stop emailing me pls

This is not a delivery problem, the parcel arrived on time, and I don't want a refund. The bench that came is the wrong one, the curved backrest model, not the straight one I ordered. I'm honestly annoyed about this. I need to send it back, so how do I arrange that?

Hi, I'm a bit nervous about my wooden garden bench, order LK-205814. Before I put it outside, could you please tell me what the guarantee actually covers, such as rot or weather damage, and for how long? I'd rather know now than find out the hard way.

good afternoon, i would like to report a possible safety problem with the step ladder i bought. one of the rungs wobbles when i stand on it and the hinge bar made a cracking sound the other day when i opened it. ive only used it a few times around the house. could someone please look into this? i dont want anyone getting hurt
hey, my promo code didn't take off the total

I'm worried because the courier tracking says my greenhouse was delivered yesterday, but nothing has arrived at my door. I've checked the side gate, the back porch and the neighbours' driveways. Could you please look into this? I'm not sure what to do next and I'm concerned the parcel may have been taken.

Good morning. This is not a delivery problem and I am not requesting a refund. I simply wish to understand what the guarantee on my watering can covers and for how long. Could you please advise? Kind regards, David.

Hi there. I ordered a pressure washer a couple of weeks ago, order LK-639482, and I've been looking forward to it since our patio has been a mess all winter. When the parcels came there were two boxes, and I assumed the second one was the hose and nozzle kit. I opened the main box, took out the washer, and started setting it up in the garage. Then I went to find the accessory box and it simply isn't here. The packing slip lists three items but I only have the washer and one small bag of fittings. The delivery itself was fine, the driver was friendly and left everything by the side gate. Could you check whether one of the boxes went missing and tell me how the rest of the order will reach me? Thanks.

Hi! Quick heads up, I think there might be a safety issue with the bed linen set. I noticed a loose seam near the zip and a strong chemical smell after the first wash. I've only used it twice so far. Could someone have a look at it? Happy to send photos. Thanks so much!
Please delete my account and personal data. Thank you.

Good day. This is not a query about delivery or an existing order. I would like to know whether it is possible to pay for a bed linen set in instalments, or by bank transfer instead of by card. Could you please advise on the available options? Yours sincerely, Helen Ard.
Panicking a bit, how do I return cushion covers?

hi sorry to bother u again but my robot vacuum tracking hasnt moved since tuesday. its been like 5 days now and it just says label created. im getting really worried it got lost. can u check whats going on pls

Hi there! I've had the solar path lights for about two months and they worked great at first. Lately a couple of them have started flickering, and one has a little water inside the lens after the rain. They used to charge fine in the sun. Could you let me know what my options are? Thanks a lot for your help!

Dear Larkfield support, I bought a hammock last spring and would be grateful if you could delete my customer account together with all personal data you hold about me, in line with my rights under applicable privacy law. Please confirm once this has been completed. Yours faithfully, Samuel Okafor

Hello, I bought a wool rug from you last month and would like to update the email address on my account. My old address is one I no longer check, and I want order updates going to the new one. Could you let me know how to change it, or do it for me? Thank you, Marion

Not a delivery problem and I don't want a refund, the fire pit arrived fine. I just need a proper invoice with VAT shown for my order. My company needs it for an expense claim and the confirmation email doesn't include it. Why is this so hard to get? Please send it today.
Pan tracking hasn't updated in four days. Seriously?

Hi, I think I've been locked out of my account after too many login attempts. I was trying to check the status of my greenhouse order LK-734810 and now it says the account is temporarily blocked. I'm worried I won't be able to track the delivery or find the invoice. How long does the lock last, and can you help me get back in? Thanks, Priya

Good morning. The courier tracking for my set of terracotta pots shows delivered on Tuesday, however nothing has arrived at my property. My previous delivery from you was smooth, and I also received a refund for an earlier item, so I'm not sure what happened here. I was logged in when I placed this order, and the parcel was supposed to be left at the side gate. Please could you look into this with the courier. Regards, Helen
Order LK-109374. What does the guarantee on the frying pan cover, and for how long?
Sorted the bank side already, my card limit was the issue. Now the bird feeder checkout still says declined on a card that works everywhere else. Can you check?

hi i sent the frying pan back on monday for order LK-552018 and im worried it didnt get there. the tracking says left the post office but nothing since. did u guys receive it?? i need to know if the refund can go through

Hello there! I ordered a raised vegetable bed under order LK-318847, but the box that arrived contains a compost sieve instead. Could you arrange for me to send it back and get the correct raised bed out to me? I'm happy to pay return postage if needed, just let me know how. Thanks so much!

Thanks for the update on my earlier question about the lawn mower order. The confirmation email said it would arrive by the 12th of this month, and I have been home every day since. Order LK-690231 still hasn't turned up and the date has now passed. Could you tell me where the parcel is?
Can I pay for the leaf blower in instalments or by bank transfer? Card isn't ideal for me.

Hi again! The solar path lights arrived and the first one has been working great in the garden for about two weeks. Last night I noticed one of them was getting really hot, and the plastic casing was warping near the battery. I've already switched it off and moved it away from the house. Is this something I should report as a safety problem, and what's the next step?

Hi, I'm sorry to write in a bit of a state, I've had a rough week. Last Thursday my partner and I were finally sorting out the garden and decided on a compost bin, which I ordered from you on the 3rd. Then on Friday my old work email got shut off because the company changed its system, and I realised my account is still linked to that address. I've already missed a shipping update because the messages went nowhere, and I'm worried the next one will go to a dead inbox too. The order is LK-205761 and I don't want to lose track of it. Could you please change the email address on my account to the personal one I'm using now, the address I'm sending this from? Thank you so much, I really appreciate it, Dana

Good afternoon, the courier has marked my trampoline delivery as complete, but nothing has been left at my address and I have not received it. I checked with my neighbours and the porch as well. Could you look into this with the courier and let me know the next steps? Thank you.
hey whats the guarantee on the electric kettle, like what does it cover and how long is it for. bought it a couple weeks ago

I was trying to check my order for the garden hose reel earlier and kept getting the password wrong, probably because I had two saved. After a few tries the page says I'm locked out. Can you tell me how to get back into my account?
Not a delivery issue and I'm keeping the leaf blower. My card was charged twice for the same order. Can you remove the duplicate charge?

Good morning. I've placed an order that includes a pressure washer and a large garden shed kit, and the shed panels are too heavy for one person to carry safely. Could you arrange a two-person delivery booking for that item? I'm happy to take any available morning slot. Many thanks.

hi sorry im prob being dumb but i cant find a vat receipt for the pruning shears anywhere. my work needs one for the expense claim and they wont accept the normal confirmation email. can u send me a proper invoice pls, im kinda panicking since the deadline is friday

ok so the wooden garden bench has a crack in the seat already and its only been 6 weeks. is it under guarantee?? i really dont want to pay for a new one. can i get a replacement sent out, im worried itll get worse and someone gets hurt
Hi, the pots came on Tuesday and I've already unpacked the first box, they look great. The order said two boxes but only one arrived, so I'm missing the second one. Could you tell me where it is?
Hello, I sent the shed back last week on order LK-318647 using the return label from your email. The tracking says it was delivered on the 14th. Could you confirm whether you've received it?

Hello, my bird feeder worked well when I first installed it. About three weeks later, water started leaking from the seam where the tray joins the base, and a small crack has appeared there. I would like to know what options are available for a repair or replacement. Thank you.
Put the 8ft trampoline together, all good. Can I swap it for the 10ft on LK-605128?

Set the desk lamp up last night and the light works really well, thanks for the quick dispatch. The order came in two cartons though and only the lamp box turned up. Could you check whether the second one is still on its way?

The wool rug arrived last month and the delivery was smooth, no complaints there. I also got a refund for an earlier order that went through without trouble. I keep getting marketing emails even after logging in and unticking the boxes, so please take me off the marketing list.
Please outline hose reel guarantee coverage and duration.

Hiya! The solar path lights arrived really quickly and I'm happy with them. I got a refund for a cushion last spring too, all sorted. Anyway, I entered code SPRING15 at checkout and the discount didn't come off my total. Could you help?

ok so the greenhouse is way too big for my yard and i need to send it back. order LK-771039. the email said to get a return label but i cant find it anywhere, ive checked my inbox twice and the account page. can u send me the label or instructions asap pls

Good afternoon. The kettle was delivered without any issues, and I logged in without difficulty to check my order. I also received a refund for a previous purchase last month. However, the discount code WELCOME10 was not applied to my total at checkout. Would you please review this?

hi sorry im kinda panicking. i ordered the terracotta pots but what came is some other planters, wrong shape and size. i dont want them. how do i send it back?? im scared ill end up paying for the postage x

Sorry, I'm not sure this is the right way to ask, so bear with me. Last month I ordered pruning shears for my mum, order LK-209384. They were lovely for about two weeks, then the handle started wobbling and the blade stopped closing properly. Mum was really upset, and I spent an evening trying to fix them with oil and a screwdriver, which didn't help. Now I need to send them back along with a heavy garden cart that came in the same delivery, and I can't lift it to a post office with my back the way it is. My mum isn't able to manage it either, and I keep worrying I'll end up paying for postage on something that was faulty. Could someone arrange a collection from her house, and can you tell me what I need to do to get it booked?
Grill broke, guarantee replacement possible? Please help!
bench armrest snapped off just from sitting on it lol. nothing crazy, normal use. can someone arrange a repair?
hiii so my hose reel crank handle snapped off after like 2 months, we only used it for watering :) order LK-553201. could you send me a replacement under the guarantee?

I've been using the tool chest most weekends since it arrived, and it worked well until recently. The second drawer runner has seized and the lock no longer engages after about four months. Could you advise what the next steps are for getting this looked at? Thank you, Dan

Hi, the log store I ordered (order LK-318462) came today and the outer box is crushed on one side. When I opened it the store is cracked and some pieces are broken inside. The delivery itself was smooth and I was even happy about my last refund going through, but now I'm worried it's ruined. What do I do from here? I'm honestly a bit panicked.

Hello, this isn't a delivery problem and I don't want a refund. My barbecue grill order (LK-774120) total didn't drop when I entered my code SUMMER10 at checkout. The discount line never showed up, so I paid full price. Could you check why the code didn't apply? Thank you.

Ugh, I just realised I put the wrong address on my hammock order and I can't find where to change it. My login works fine so it's not that. Can you change the delivery address before it goes out? Or change the delivery day to a different slot if the address can't be fixed. Please reply today.

I'm really anxious because I tried to pay for my cast iron frying pan order LK-630817 and the card was declined. The same card works fine everywhere else, including my bank app and a shop yesterday. I even logged in without any trouble. Could you tell me why it's being refused? I don't want to lose the order.

Good morning. I am writing regarding my hammock order LK-905242. The promotional code I entered at checkout did not reduce the order total. I would be grateful if you could review the order and apply the correct discount. Kind regards.

Hi there, this isn't about the delivery being late and I don't want a refund. My bird feeder order arrived but one of the boxes is missing. The order showed two boxes and I only have one. Could you check what was sent and send the missing box? Thanks.
Hi, my kitchen bin is quite big. Can I book a two person delivery so they can carry it in? Thanks.

Hello, I'm thinking about my garden shed purchase and wanted to ask what the guarantee actually covers. Does it include the roof and the door hinges? Also, how long does the guarantee last from the delivery date? Thank you for your help.
Hi, I need to send back my curtain pole because it doesn't fit. It's a bulky item, so I'd like to book a collection rather than drop it off. Can you arrange that for me? Thanks.
Did you get my electric kettle return? Posted last week.

Hello, my fire pit worked perfectly for the first few months but now the burner has stopped working completely, even though I've used it normally and haven't damaged it. I did get a shipping confirmation and logged in to check, but that's not the issue. Could you let me know what my options are? Thanks so much.
hi please stop sending me marketing emails. i dont want a refund or anything just take me off the list. order LK-208475 was fine btw
Where is my trampoline? Expected date passed!

Hello, I'd like to book a two-person delivery for my cushion covers order. The parcel is a large box, so I'd like two people to carry it in. Could you tell me how to set that up and whether there's an extra fee? Thank you.

Hi, I hope you can help. The tracking for my pruning shears hasn't changed for several days and it still says in transit. I tried logging into my account to check the details, which worked fine. Could you let me know where the parcel is? Thanks in advance.

Thanks again for sorting out my address confusion last week, that's all good now. The garden shed arrived on time and the assembly went smoothly. The only problem is the colour I received isn't the one I wanted, so can I exchange it for the other colour?

Hi! Thanks for the smooth delivery on my bed linen set, everything arrived in perfect condition. Could you send me an invoice or a VAT receipt for the order? My company needs it for my expenses. Cheers!
hey so my watering can cracked at the seam after like 2 wks, order LK-553901. is there a replacement under the guarantee or wat do i do now

Hey! Loved the delivery speed on my wooden garden bench, but I think a box is missing. The bench order had three boxes and I only got two. Could you check whether the third one was sent? Thanks a lot, I appreciate it!

Dear Sir or Madam, I would be grateful for clarification on the guarantee for my pruning shears. Could you please confirm what the guarantee covers and for what period it applies from the date of purchase? Yours faithfully.

Hi. I need to book a two-person delivery for the greenhouse I ordered. The frame is heavy and the panels are glass, so one person can't lift it safely. My login was a bit slow today, but that's separate. Can you set up a two-person delivery slot? Thanks, Marta

Hi there! I'd like my account deleted along with all my personal data, including my name, address and phone number. I don't need the account anymore. Could you confirm once it's done? Thanks so much, Dev
Hey! Quick one: my bank shows two charges for the raised vegetable bed order, same amount, same day. I only placed one order. Could you check and reverse the extra one? Cheers

This is the third time I've checked and the tracking for my log store has been stuck on 'label created' for five days. Nothing has moved. Is it lost, or what? I need to know when it's actually coming.

My order LK-713086 shows as delivered by the courier, but nothing arrived at my door. I checked the porch, the side gate and with the neighbours. The trampoline is not here. Could you look into what happened?
I entered the code SPRING15 at checkout for the cast iron frying pan, but the total didn't change. The code says it should be valid until the end of the month. Can you tell me why it wasn't applied?

good morning i would be grateful if you could look into my compost bin delivery the courier left it with a neighbour two doors down without asking me first i was not home and i did not agree to that please advise how this will be resolved thank you

Hi, I'm really worried. The drawer on my tool chest started making a grinding noise, and now one corner looks like it's rusting. It worked fine for the first month. I'm not sure it's safe to keep my tools in it. I'd also like to know if this is covered. I had a refund mix-up before and I'm nervous. My login isn't working either, so I'm using a friend's laptop.

Thanks to whoever helped me with the delivery last week. That's all sorted and the parcel arrived fine, and the lamp worked well on the first day. But since yesterday it has started buzzing loudly and flickering when I dim it. Is this a fault you can have looked at or replaced?
Did you receive my hose reel return?
